name: Scythe IV
description: The Scythe IV was a G1-M4-C Dunelizard fighter in service during the Galactic Civil War. It was the personal starship of Hortrix Steelarm, a smuggler working for the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure. Hortrix Steelarm was killed sometime after the Battle of Yavin when the Scythe IV was destroyed by a pilot working for the rival Valarian Syndicate.
